recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If OO wants the vital-signs page or profiles to return to Trial-Use, that should be decided in a new tracker rather than by replaying the older status portion of FHIR-39448.
issue_request: FHIR-39448 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for the Observation Vital Signs page. It requested changing the main page title from "Observation Vital Signs Panel Profile" to "Observation Vital Signs Profiles", changing the page standards status to Trial-Use, replacing the Observation core profiles introductory sentence in section 10.1.1.1, and allowing author-discretion consistency edits.
initial_application: Commit 5780bcef002a changed the Observation core profiles paragraph and removed the old main-page Panel Profile title, commit d111dbac0547 made the main page title plural as Observation Vital Signs Profiles, PR #3100 merged those FHIR-39448 changes, and commit 57a441fde8b later added trial-use status to the vital-signs IG. FHIR-46418 subsequently stated that its broader pre-applied vital-signs rework should update and complete FHIR-39448.
additional_context: The relevant source is in current build scope through the active Observation resource, the Observation pack list, and ImplementationGuide/Observation-vitalsigns. The old main-page title remains absent; the only current "Observation Vital Signs Panel Profile" title is on the actual vitalspanel StructureDefinition, where panel is semantically correct. Later commit 9a5f0357ef changed the vital-signs IG/profiles back to normative and removed the Trial Use label from the Observation core profiles heading, and FHIR-53553 later recorded the R6 Observation Normative-status ballot-note context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current source already reflects the requested title and wording, and reverting the current normative status to the older trial-use request would conflict with later applied build state.
